chunks.title: Kit/Pack Management
chunks.heading: Solution › Kit/Pack Management
chunks.text:
Current Behaviour
• Style Type is displayed based on a system setting.
• It contains two dropdown options:
• Single
• Kit
Proposed Requirement / Enhancement
1. Style Type (Old BOM)
• Style Type will be applicable only when the user is working with the Old BOM.
• It will function exactly as per the existing behaviour (no change).
2. Component Type (New BOM)
• A new field “Component Type” will be introduced for New BOM.
• It will be displayed based on the same configuration setting logic used for Style Type.
• This field will appear only when the user is working with New BOM.
• Dropdown options:
• Single
• Multi
The Component Type field will be available as a dropdown with the following options:
• Single
• Multi
Based on the user’s selection:
• If Single is selected, a “Pack” tab will be enabled on the header.
• If Multi is selected, a “Kit” tab will be enabled on the header.

chunks.title: Configure Kit/Pack
chunks.heading: Solution › Configure Kit/Pack
chunks.text:
User had already made Two or more articles for e.g.: Shirt and Trouser with their respective BOM(Manufacturing BOM) , Now when we create a New techpack Name Shirt-Trouser KIT in BOM we are going to select those articles(pant and trouser), Now when we configure a techpack all the articles present in the BOM of kit will be shown in the dropdown & and if user want to create a new techpack he can do that with drop down under article and to create New BOM that can also be done from Manufacturing BOM dropdown.
Clicking on “Configure Kit/Pack” opens the Create Kit/Pack screen.
• When the user selects “Single” in the Component Type on the Techpack, the style details will be automatically picked up and populated under the Pack Items (Article) tab.
• When the user selects “Multi”, the designated two or more styles intended to be part of the kit will be automatically picked up and populated under the Kit Items (Article) tab.

chunks.title: Kit Items (Articles) Tab
chunks.heading: Solution › Configure Kit/Pack › Kit Items (Articles) Tab
chunks.text:
This tab defines the articles/items included in a Kit/Pack BOM.
Functionality
• Displays Kit Articles & Variations
• Defines how many articles are included in a kit (e.g., 2 T-shirts in one kit)
Actions
• Add:
• User clicks on “Add Item” (shown in images)
• User can add multiple articles Inside kit(if existing will come directly in dropdown if not then we can create new Article) same for BOM.
• Each article contains:
• Article selection
• Color (Multi-select)
• Size (Multi-select)
• Auto-generated SKU
• Quantity
• Manufacturing BOM selection
• View BOM – Hyperlink Functionality:
A “View & Edit” hyperlink will be provided adjacent to the Manufacturing BOM field.
• On clicking the “View” hyperlink, the system will open the BOM details screen in view mode and user can also edit it when permissions enabled.
• The user will be able to review all BOM line items and related details in a read-only format.
chunks.locator: § Solution › Configure Kit/Pack › Kit Items (Articles) Tab

chunks.title: Add New Article Functionality (Within Article Dropdown):
chunks.heading: Solution › Configure Kit/Pack › Kit Items (Articles) Tab › Add New Article Functionality (Within Article Dropdown):
chunks.text:
Within the Article column dropdown, an option “Add New Article” will be available.
• On clicking “Add New Article,” a right-side panel will be opened.
The panel will contain the following fields:
• Product Group – Dropdown (Single Select)
• Sub-category – Dropdown (Single Select)
• Article Name – Editable Field
• Buyer Style Reference – Editable Field
• Article Code – Editable Field
• Color – Dropdown (Multi-select)
• Size – Dropdown (Multi-select)
At the bottom of the panel, the following actions will be available:
• Cancel
• Save Article
On clicking “Save Article”:
• The article will be saved in the system.
• The newly created article will be available in the Article dropdown list for selection
Behaviour
• Multiple selections of color/size automatically generate combinations (child rows)
• Horizontal scrolling is supported for viewing all fields
chunks.locator: § Solution › Configure Kit/Pack › Kit Items (Articles) Tab › Add New Article Functionality (Within Article Dropdown):

chunks.title: Add New BOM Functionality (Within Manufacturing BOM Dropdown):
chunks.heading: Solution › Configure Kit/Pack › Kit Items (Articles) Tab › Add New BOM Functionality (Within Manufacturing BOM Dropdown):
chunks.text:
Manufacturing BOM Selection & Attachment Logic
• When the user clicks on “New BOM” from the Manufacturing BOM dropdown, the system will open the Article BOM screen.
• The user can create and configure a new BOM for the selected article and save it either in:
• Saved mode, or
• Confirmed mode
• Once the BOM is saved or confirmed, it will be available in the Manufacturing BOM dropdown.
Selection & Confirmation Behavior
• If the user selects a Confirmed BOM from the dropdown and confirms:
• The BOM will be directly attached to the article.
• If the user selects a Saved BOM from the dropdown and confirms the Kit/Pack page:
• The selected BOM will be automatically approved (converted to Confirmed)
• The BOM will then be attached to the article for further transactions.
Key Behaviour Summary
• Saved BOM → Gets auto-confirmed on selection + confirmation action
• Confirmed BOM → Gets directly attached
• Only Saved/Confirmed BOMs appear in the dropdown

chunks.title: Summary Tab
chunks.heading: Solution › Configure Kit/Pack › Summary Tab
chunks.text:
This tab provides a complete overview of the Kit/Pack (shown in images).
a. Kit Information
• Kit ID
• Kit Name
• Ratio Type
• Kit SKU
b. BOM Line Items
Displays combined data from:
• Kit Items
• Packaging Materials
• Other Costs
Fields
• Line #
• Item Type
• Item Code/Article
• Description
• Quantity
• UOM
• Unit Cost
• Total Cost
BOM Line Items – Summary & Expansion Behaviour:
In the BOM Line Items (Summary Section):
• The summary view will populate the following details for the selected style(s):
• Style Description
• Quantity
• UOM
• Selling Price – Unit Price
• Total Cost
• On clicking/expanding the style line item:
• The system will display the materials used to construct that style (i.e., underlying BOM components such as fabric, trims, etc.).
• If Kit is configured:
• Multiple styles will be displayed under the Kit Items tab in the summary.
• Each style will support the same expand/collapse functionality, showing its respective material breakdown.
c. Cost Summary
Provides financial breakdown:
• Total Cost
• Selling Price
• Discount
• Profit
• Markup
• SMV – This comes on the basis of configuration and setting.
• EPM – This comes on the basis of configuration and setting.
